connections.why: Noether's theorem of 1918 explains the law Joule and Helmholtz established: energy is conserved because the laws of physics are the same at every moment of time.

Noether came to Göttingen in 1915 to help Hilbert with energy in Einstein's new theory of gravity, and her second theorem of 1918 proved Hilbert's assertion that energy is not conserved there in the ordinary sense.
